legal_status_line.sw: Kufikiria kujiua sio kosa la jinai nchini Kenya.
legal_status_line.en: Thinking about suicide is not a criminal offence in Kenya.
legal_status_line.basis: KNCHR & 2 others v AG, Petition E045 of 2022, [2025] KEHC 6, 9 January 2025 — attempted suicide declared unconstitutional, immediate effect, no suspension. Penal Code s.226 is still printed pending formal repeal (NA Bill No. 53 of 2024), so many women still believe disclosure is criminal.

_jurisdiction_note: Kenya only. Tanzania is materially different: attempted suicide remains a crime (Penal Code Cap. 16 R.E. 2023, s.217) and there is no national adult suicide-prevention line. A Tanzanian deployment needs a different disclosure script and a different safeguarding pathway.

contacts.why_listed: Domestic violence carries OR 6.34 (95% CI 4.11–9.78) for postpartum depression in East Africa (Negesse 2022, doi:10.1177/20503121221135403). A GBV pathway is a predictable branch, not an add-on.

contacts.why_last: §4.2 records the mother's trust requirement as knowing that speaking will not bring the police or take her baby. For an adolescent mother a child-protection number is precisely the outcome she fears. Placed last, under 'for immediate danger only', and not read aloud from the script.
